description: See every question, bug and todo your agent raises in one panel beside the thread, so nothing gets lost in the scroll. Items are numbered Q1, B1, T1: answer in chat with "Q3 clerk", or "go" to accept every recommendation. Agents add and close items themselves through the board_add and board_close tools, in every thread and with every provider. If a reply asks a question or finishes work without updating the board, the agent gets one reminder; you can turn this off in settings.
